reviews.title: They make it very difficult to cancel
reviews.text: They make it very difficult to cancel and the chat bot was telling me to select things that didn’t exist. Misleading and a really poor way to get customers to stay.

reviews.title: Do not sign up to this!
reviews.text: They will lock you into a subscription with no way to cancel if you’re on mobile or iPad, the only way to change your subscription is to use desktop, but if you travel like myself you have no way to cancel. The customer service is awful and they give no prior warning to subscription renewals. Avoid at all costs, there is plenty better schedulers out there.

reviews.title: So many problems
reviews.text:
I am so done with this app. I’ve emailed them no less than 5 times over the months to fix my “best time to post” feature because I’m a paid subscriber and it wasn’t working. The latest time is on 12/2 when Support responded and told me that the feature is no longer available on iOS and only on Desktop. I checked on desktop and the feature gave me no best time to post today, and the following day times were between 1 am and 2 am. 

Beyond this, Later doesn’t keep up with IG updates - for example it still says you can’t upload more than 10 photos at a time. 

Beyond this, you can’t preview a post like a normal Instagram post, you have to click on each individual photo and go down the line.

I’m not sure the point of this app, it’s a lot of play pretend. I canceled my subscription today.
